title: Pure Power Patron
summary: Power Patron cards with Medius the Pure, the Theorealize Spells and generic staples. Medius fetches the Level 1 Pendulum Shade Power Patrons (Nervedo, Jupredo and Junoldo), which banish the top three cards of your Deck to transform into their Extra Deck Patrons and then trigger again from the face-up Extra Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Medius the Pure adds or Special Summons a Power Patron monster from the Deck when summoned, and shuffles a monster from your hand or field into the Deck to revive itself from the GY.
Theorealized Medius (counted as a Power Patron card) Special Summons itself while a Power Patron card is on the field and searches any Theorealize card.

Prohibited Power Patron Portal - Terminus (Limited to 1) sends a Power Patron from the Deck to the GY to search a DARK Fairy such as Medius the Pure, and Plundered Power Patron Plane - Vidolia reveals an Extra Deck Patron to add or summon the Shade that names it.

summary.title: Opening: Medius the Pure
steps: Normal Summon Medius the Pure to Special Summon Nervedo the Shadebeast Power Patron (or Jupredo or Junoldo) from the Deck.

Link Summon Purification Power Patron using Medius and the Shade to search Theorealize Liberation, then trigger the Shade face-up in the Extra Deck to summon a second Shade, search a Power Patron Spell/Trap or recover a card.

Activate Theorealize Liberation or revive Medius from the GY to bring out the remaining Shades; banish the top three cards of your Deck with each Shade to cheat out Nerva, Jupiter or Junora and climb into Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron.

summary.title: The Three Shades & Extra Deck Patrons
points: Nervedo the Shadebeast Power Patron banishes the top three cards of the Deck to become Nerva the Power Patron of Creation (Fusion), and when sent to the Extra Deck face-up it Special Summons a Power Patron from the Deck.

Jupredo the Shademachine Power Patron banishes the top three cards of the Deck to become Jupiter the Power Patron of Destruction (Xyz), and from the face-up Extra Deck it searches a Power Patron Spell/Trap.

Junoldo the Shadespirit Power Patron banishes the top three cards of the Deck to become Junora the Power Patron of Tuning (Synchro, which negates the opponent's face-up cards on summon), and from the face-up Extra Deck it returns a Power Patron card to the hand.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron (Link-3 requiring an Extra Deck monster) negates and halves the ATK of opposing monsters, and once it points to three monsters it banishes the opponent's entire field.
Vidolium the Unstable Power Patron of Unity returns a Fusion, a Synchro and an Xyz Monster you control or in your GY to the Extra Deck to Special Summon itself and banish every card in both GYs.
Purification Power Patron (Link-2) searches a Theorealize card on summon and performs a Link Summon during either Main Phase.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Theorealize Liberation adds or Special Summons a 300 ATK / 200 DEF Shade from the Deck while Medius is out; Theorealize Past Lull summons Medius unrespondably while you control a Shade (each counts as Artmage, DoomZ or Elfnote); and Theorealize Overdrive revives Medius from the GY or banishment.

Prohibitive Power Patron Purview - Vilaea makes your Power Patron effects unrespondable when you reveal Nerva, Jupiter and Junora, and Power Patron Shade of the Final Hour summons a Power Patron and banishes opposing cards per Extra Deck card type you control.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's combo lines add the Ars Magna sub-engine, and the Level 1 Artmage, DoomZ and Elfnote Power Patrons are omitted here because each one locks your Extra Deck to a single monster card type.
